A '''skirmish''' was fought by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] attempting to escape an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]]. [[Elora Silssusio]] sustained serious injuries in the skirmish, causing [[Gender/Legends|her]] to be taken to [[Polis Massa/Legends|Polis Massa]] for treatment.<ref name="Strongholds" />
